
=== WebPanel: Embarques.ProductsWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Product'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Embarques.ProductsWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Embarques.ProductsWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ProductNumber.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ProductDesc.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ProductUnit.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	ProductCost.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ProductType.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	Packaging.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	SubProductType.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	ProductExist.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	ProductGroup.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	DB.ProductPiecesPlt.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	Product8020.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	ProductPallets.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductNumber'
					&TFProductNumber = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductNumber_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductDesc'
					&TFProductDesc = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductDesc_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductUnit'
					&TFProductUnit = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductUnit_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductCost'
					&TFProductCost.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductCost_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductType'
					&TFProductType = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductType_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'Packaging'
					&TFPackaging = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPackaging_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'SubProductType'
					&TFSubProductType = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFSubProductType_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductExist'
					&TFProductExist.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductExist_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductGroup'
					&TFProductGroup = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductGroup_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductPiecesPlt'
					&TFProductPiecesPlt.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductPiecesPlt_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'Product8020'
					&TFProduct8020 = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProduct8020_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductPallets'
					&TFProductPallets.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductPallets_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = DB.Product.Link(TrnMode.Update, ProductNumber)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.Product.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ProductNumber)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Embarques.ProductsWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Embarques.ProductsWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Embarques.ProductsWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Embarques.ProductsWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.Product.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ProductNumber))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDC_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'Product', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord, '', '')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: DB.Product ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ProductNumber);

ProductNumber = &ProductNumber if not &ProductNumber.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductNumber) if not &ProductNumber.IsEmpty();
noprompt(ProductNumber);

}

LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Embarques.ProductsWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"ProductsWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductNumber_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductNumber.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductDesc_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripción")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductDesc_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductDesc.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripción")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductDesc)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductUnit_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Unit")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductUnit_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductUnit.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Unit")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductUnit)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductCost.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductCost_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cost")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductCost
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductCost_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductType_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tipo Producto")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductType_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductType.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tipo Producto")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductType)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFPackaging_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Packaging")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFPackaging_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFPackaging.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Packaging")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFPackaging)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSubProductType_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sub Product Type")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFSubProductType_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFSubProductType.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sub Product Type")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFSubProductType)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductExist.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductExist_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Exist")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductExist
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductExist_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductGroup_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Group")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductGroup_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductGroup.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Group")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductGroup)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductPiecesPlt.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductPiecesPlt_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Pieces Plt")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductPiecesPlt
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductPiecesPlt_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProduct8020_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Product8020")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProduct8020_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProduct8020.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Product8020")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProduct8020)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductPallets.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductPallets_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Pallets")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFProductPallets
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFProductPallets_To
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Embarques.ProductsWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Embarques.ProductsWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Product
		order ProductDesc  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductDesc)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductUnit  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductUnit)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductCost  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductCost)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductType  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductType)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order Packaging  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (Packaging)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SubProductType  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SubProductType)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductExist  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductExist)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductGroup  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductGroup)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductPiecesPlt  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductPiecesPlt)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order Product8020  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (Product8020)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using ProductsWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel, &TFProductDesc, &TFProductDesc_Sel, &TFProductUnit
					, &TFProductUnit_Sel, &TFProductCost, &TFProductCost_To, &TFProductType, &TFProductType_Sel, &TFPackaging
					, &TFPackaging_Sel, &TFSubProductType, &TFSubProductType_Sel, &TFProductExist, &TFProductExist_To, &TFProductGroup
					, &TFProductGroup_Sel, &TFProductPiecesPlt, &TFProductPiecesPlt_To, &TFProduct8020, &TFProduct8020_Sel, &TFProductPallets
					, &TFProductPallets_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductNumber'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductNumber)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductDesc'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductDesc)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductUnit'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductUnit)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductCost'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductCost
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductType'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductType)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'Packaging'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Packaging)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SubProductType'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(SubProductType)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductExist'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductExist
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductGroup'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductGroup)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductPiecesPlt'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductPiecesPlt
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'Product8020'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Product8020)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductPallets'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ProductPallets
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductNumber", '', !'Producto', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductDesc", '', !'Descripción', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductUnit", '', !'Unit', True, '')

	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductType", '', !'Tipo Producto', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"Packaging", '', !'Packaging', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SubProductType", '', !'Sub Product Type', True, '')

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.

		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Embarques.ProductsWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Embarques.ProductsWWGridState"))

=== Procedure: Embarques.ProductsWWExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'productsww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Product List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductNumber_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductNumber_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductNumber.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductNumber
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductDesc_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductDesc_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductDesc.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductDesc
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductUnit_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductUnit_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductUnit.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductUnit
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductCost.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductCost_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductCost
		&TFProductCost_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Cost", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductCost_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductType_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductType_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductType.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductType
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFPackaging_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFPackaging_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFPackaging.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFPackaging
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFSubProductType_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFSubProductType_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFSubProductType.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFSubProductType
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductExist.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductExist_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductExist
		&TFProductExist_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Exist", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductExist_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductGroup_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductGroup_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductGroup.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductGroup
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductPiecesPlt.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductPiecesPlt_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductPiecesPlt
		&TFProductPiecesPlt_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Pieces Plt", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductPiecesPlt_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFProduct8020_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProduct8020_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProduct8020.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProduct8020
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductPallets.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductPallets_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductPallets
		&TFProductPallets_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Pallets", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductPallets_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Product
		order ProductDesc  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductDesc)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductUnit  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductUnit)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DB.ProductCost  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductCost)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductType  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductType)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order Packaging  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (Packaging)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SubProductType  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SubProductType)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductExist  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductExist)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order DB.ProductGroup  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductGroup)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductPiecesPlt  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductPiecesPlt)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order Product8020  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (Product8020)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using ProductsWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel, &TFProductDesc, &TFProductDesc_Sel, &TFProductUnit
					, &TFProductUnit_Sel, &TFProductCost, &TFProductCost_To, &TFProductType, &TFProductType_Sel, &TFPackaging
					, &TFPackaging_Sel, &TFSubProductType, &TFSubProductType_Sel, &TFProductExist, &TFProductExist_To, &TFProductGroup
					, &TFProductGroup_Sel, &TFProductPiecesPlt, &TFProductPiecesPlt_To, &TFProduct8020, &TFProduct8020_Sel, &TFProductPallets
					, &TFProductPallets_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: Embarques.ProductsWWGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTNUMBER'
		Do 'LoadProductNumberOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTDESC'
		Do 'LoadProductDescOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTUNIT'
		Do 'LoadProductUnitOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTTYPE'
		Do 'LoadProductTypeOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PACKAGING'
		Do 'LoadPackagingOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_SUBPRODUCTTYPE'
		Do 'LoadSubProductTypeOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCTGROUP'
		Do 'LoadProductGroupOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRODUCT8020'
		Do 'LoadProduct8020Options'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

Sub 'LoadProductNumberOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFProductNumber = &SearchTxt
	&TFProductNumber_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Product
		Order ProductNumber
		using ProductsWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel, &TFProductDesc, &TFProductDesc_Sel, &TFProductUnit
					, &TFProductUnit_Sel, &TFProductCost, &TFProductCost_To, &TFProductType, &TFProductType_Sel, &TFPackaging
					, &TFPackaging_Sel, &TFSubProductType, &TFSubProductType_Sel, &TFProductExist, &TFProductExist_To, &TFProductGroup
					, &TFProductGroup_Sel, &TFProductPiecesPlt, &TFProductPiecesPlt_To, &TFProduct8020, &TFProduct8020_Sel, &TFProductPallets
					, &TFProductPallets_To)

		Option Distinct
		If not ProductNumber.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ProductNumber
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadProductDescOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFProductDesc = &SearchTxt
	&TFProductDesc_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Product
		Order ProductDesc
		using ProductsWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel, &TFProductDesc, &TFProductDesc_Sel, &TFProductUnit
					, &TFProductUnit_Sel, &TFProductCost, &TFProductCost_To, &TFProductType, &TFProductType_Sel, &TFPackaging
					, &TFPackaging_Sel, &TFSubProductType, &TFSubProductType_Sel, &TFProductExist, &TFProductExist_To, &TFProductGroup
					, &TFProductGroup_Sel, &TFProductPiecesPlt, &TFProductPiecesPlt_To, &TFProduct8020, &TFProduct8020_Sel, &TFProductPallets
					, &TFProductPallets_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Product
			Order ProductDesc
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ProductDesc.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ProductDesc
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadProductUnitOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFProductUnit = &SearchTxt
	&TFProductUnit_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Product
		Order ProductUnit
		using Embarques.ProductsWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel, &TFProductDesc, &TFProductDesc_Sel, &TFProductUnit
					, &TFProductUnit_Sel, &TFProductCost, &TFProductCost_To, &TFProductType, &TFProductType_Sel, &TFPackaging
					, &TFPackaging_Sel, &TFSubProductType, &TFSubProductType_Sel, &TFProductExist, &TFProductExist_To, &TFProductGroup
					, &TFProductGroup_Sel, &TFProductPiecesPlt, &TFProductPiecesPlt_To, &TFProduct8020, &TFProduct8020_Sel, &TFProductPallets
					, &TFProductPallets_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Product
			Order ProductUnit
			&count += 1

	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
